data.name: Master switch for semantic (vector-based) recipe search. When enabled and all dependencies are configured, search results display a green \"Search based on AI (Vector Database)\" badge and use cosine similarity ranking via the embedding model. When disabled, or when dependencies are missing, search silently falls back to keyword matching without the badge. Requires Embedding Ollama Instance (or OpenAI Chat Endpoint as fallback) and Embedding Model.
data.value: 語意（基於向量）食譜搜尋的總開關。啟用且所有依賴項目均已設定後，搜尋結果會顯示綠色的「基於 AI（向量資料庫）搜尋」標籤，並透過嵌入模型採用餘弦相似度進行排序。停用時，或缺少相關依賴項目時，搜尋將無提示回退至關鍵字匹配模式，且不顯示該標籤。需要 Embedding Ollama Instance（或 OpenAI Chat Endpoint 作為備用）及 Embedding Model。
